sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده پدرته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at the door, your father?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده، داره گريه مي کنه، سيگار مي کشه، باباته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at the door, smoking cigarette, crying, your father?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده، داره سيگار مي کشه، گريه مي کنه، روزنامه مي خونه همکارته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at the door, smoking cigarette, reading newspaper, crying, your colleague?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده داره سیگار می کشه، سوت مي زنه، دست مي زنه، همکارته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at the door, smoking cigarette, whistling, clapping, your colleague?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده، بهت چشمک مي زنه، پدرته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at the door, winking at you, your father?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده، داره دندانهاش رو مسواک مي زنه، سوت مي زنه، بهت چشمک مي زنه، همکارته؟
sentences.en: Is that man standing at door, brushing his tooth, whistling, winking at you, your colleague?

sentences.fa: اون مرده کيه که دم در ایستاده؟
sentences.en: Who is that man standing at the door?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ایستاده، داره سيگار مي کشه کيه؟
sentences.en: Who is that man standing at the door, smoking cigarette?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده داره چيکار مي کنه؟
sentences.en: What is that man standing at door doing?

sentences.fa: اون مرده که دم در ايستاده داره گریه می کنه، داره چيکار مي کنه؟
sentences.en: What is that man standing at door, crying doing?

sentences.fa: اون منتظر لولو دوست دخترش هست.
sentences.en: He is waiting for Lolo, his girlfriend.
Are you waiting for your father?
I am waiting for my mother.
Who are you waiting for?
What is your mother waiting for?

sentences.fa: اون داره به ساعتش نگاه مي کنه.
sentences.en: He is looking at his watch.

sentences.fa: اون به چي داره نگاه مي کنه؟
sentences.en: What is he looking at?

sentences.fa: مامانت داره بمن نگاه مي کنه؟
sentences.en: Is your mother looking at me?

sentences.fa: مامانت داره به چي نگاه مي کنه؟
sentences.en: What is your mother looking at?

sentences.fa: چرا داري هي بمن نگاه مي کني؟
sentences.en: Why are you looking at me over and over?

sentences.fa: چرا مادرت داره به من اينطوري نگاه مي کنه؟
sentences.en: Why is your mother looking at me like this?
Because she is late.
I am late.
My father is late.
Are you late?
Is your brother late?
Is your sister late?
Why are you late?

sentences.fa: چرا اينقدر دير کردي، نگرانت شدم؟
sentences.en: Why are you so late, I am worried about you?

sentences.fa: یه پيرمرده داره از سينما خارج مي شه.
sentences.en: An old man is coming out of the cinema.

sentences.fa: اون مرده که داره از مدرسه بيرون مي آد کيه؟
sentences.en: Who is that man coming out of the school?

sentences.fa: يه مرد جوان داره وارد سینما مي شه.
sentences.en: A young man is going into the cinema.

sentences.fa: چرا داری می ری توی اتاق من؟
sentences.en: Why are you going into my room?

sentences.fa: یه پسره داره از پله ها بالا مي دوه.
sentences.en: A boy is running up the steps.

sentences.fa: یه دختره داره از پله ها پايين مي دوه.
sentences.en: A girl is running down the steps.

sentences.fa: چرا از پله ها هي بالا پايين مي دوي؟
sentences.en: Why are you running up and down the steps over and over?

sentences.fa: یه زنه داره از صندوق بليط مي خره.
sentences.en: A woman is buying a ticket from the cashier.
Why are you buying a ticket?
Some people are queuing outside the cinema.

sentences.fa: چرا دوستات دم در صف کشيدند؟
sentences.en: Why are your friends queuing at the door?
Where is your mother sitting?
My mother is sitting in living room.
Why are you sitting here?

words.fa: بالا و پايين دويدن از پله
words.en: Run up and down the step

conversation: Peter is standing outside the cinema. He is waiting for Lolo, his girlfriend and he is looking at his watch because she is late. An old man is coming out of the cinema. A young man is going into the cinema. A boy is running up the steps. A woman's buying a ticket from the cashier. Some people are queuing outside the cinema.
